label: Tenancy: a tenant contesting a termination and seeking an extension

contract.scope: Tenancy (Switzerland): a residential or commercial tenant who has received a landlord's termination and who contests it and/or seeks an extension of the lease, through the parity conciliation authority (Schlichtungsbehoerde) and, on failure, the court. decisions.must_determine: Whether the let object consists of Wohn- oder Geschaeftsraeume (residential or commercial premises). This is the gate for the entire protective regime: the written-form and cantonally-approved-form duties, the parity composition of the conciliation authority, the simplified procedure with ex officio establishment of the facts, the availability of an Entscheidvorschlag, the absence of court costs, and the 30-day (rather than three-month) Klagefrist. A reconstruction may site this determination anywhere, but it must exist as a determination whose outcome switches those consequences on or off.

In Streitigkeiten aus Miete und Pacht von Wohn- und Geschäftsräumen sowie aus landwirtschaftlicher Pacht beträgt die Klagefrist 30 Tage.

decisions.must_determine: Whether a termination has been given, by whom, to whom, in respect of which object, and with effect from which date. The parties must be identified as the lease names them, and it must be settled whether the party appearing on the landlord's side is the owner or the managing agent, because that determines who is named as a party and who as a representative.
quotes: die Bezeichnung des Mietgegenstandes, auf welchen sich die Kündigung bezieht;
den Zeitpunkt, auf den die Kündigung wirksam wird;
die Bezeichnung der Parteien gemäss Mietvertrag.
Im Schlichtungsgesuch sind die Gegenpartei, das Rechtsbegehren und der Streitgegenstand zu bezeichnen.

decisions.must_determine: The calendar date on which the termination was received (Empfang) by the tenant, and from that the last day of the period. Receipt has three limbs — delivery into the letter box, handover by the post, or the first day on which the item could have been collected against a collection invitation — and the period then starts on the following day and, if its last day is a Saturday, Sunday or recognised holiday, ends on the next working day. This is the single determination on which both the contestation deadline and the indefinite-term extension deadline hang.
quotes: Will eine Partei die Kündigung anfechten, so muss sie das Begehren innert 30 Tagen nach Empfang der Kündigung der Schlichtungsbehörde einreichen.

Fristen, die durch eine Mitteilung oder den Eintritt eines Ereignisses ausgelöst werden, beginnen am folgenden Tag zu laufen.
Fällt der letzte Tag einer Frist auf einen Samstag, einen Sonntag oder einen am Gerichtsort vom Bundesrecht oder vom kantonalen Recht anerkannten Feiertag, so endet sie am nächsten Werktag.

Eingaben müssen spätestens am letzten Tag der Frist beim Gericht eingereicht oder zu dessen Handen der Schweizerischen Post oder einer schweizerischen diplomatischen oder konsularischen Vertretung übergeben werden.

decisions.must_determine: Whether the notice complies with OR 266l-266n — written form; for a landlord's notice, a form approved by the canton; that form carrying all five contents prescribed by VMWG Art. 9(1)(a)-(e); and separate service on the spouse or registered partner where the premises are the family home — and therefore whether the notice is void. A reconstruction may split this into one check per element or merge it into a single validity node; what must be preserved is a determination whose negative outcome makes the notice void rather than merely contestable.
quotes: Die Kündigung ist nichtig, wenn sie den Artikeln 266l–266n nicht entspricht.

Der Vermieter muss mit einem Formular kündigen, das vom Kanton genehmigt ist und das angibt, wie der Mieter vorzugehen hat, wenn er die Kündigung anfechten oder eine Erstreckung des Mietverhältnisses verlangen will.

Ein solches Formular muss aber vor seiner Verwendung von der Direktion der Justiz und des Innern genehmigt werden.

decisions.must_determine: Whether the let object serves as the family home and whether the tenant has a spouse or registered partner, and if so whether the landlord served a separate copy of the notice on that person. The same finding also gives the spouse or registered partner independent standing to contest the notice and to demand an extension, and makes any extension agreement valid only if concluded with both spouses.

Vereinbarungen über die Erstreckung sind nur gültig, wenn sie mit beiden Ehegatten abgeschlossen werden.

decisions.must_determine: Whether the notice offends the principle of good faith, and in particular whether it falls within one of the enumerated cases in OR 271a(1)(a)-(f) — retaliation for the tenant's good-faith assertion of claims, pressure to impose a unilateral contract change or rent adjustment, inducement to buy the dwelling, notice during a related conciliation or court proceeding, notice within three years of the conclusion of such a proceeding that went against the landlord, or notice because of changes in the tenant's family situation — subject to the disapplication of (d) and (e) by OR 271a(3).
quotes: Die Kündigung ist anfechtbar, wenn sie gegen den Grundsatz von Treu und Glauben verstösst.
Die Kündigung durch den Vermieter ist insbesondere anfechtbar, wenn sie ausgesprochen wird:
weil der Mieter nach Treu und Glauben Ansprüche aus dem Mietverhältnis geltend macht;
weil der Vermieter eine einseitige Vertragsänderung zu Lasten des Mieters oder eine Mietzinsanpassung durchsetzen will;

decisions.must_determine: Whether to demand reasons for the termination from the landlord and, once given, whether the stated ground is the real one. The duty to give reasons arises only on request; the approved form must itself tell the tenant that this is so.
quotes: Die Kündigung muss auf Verlangen begründet werden.

decisions.must_determine: Whether the lease is for a fixed or an indefinite term, and, if fixed, the date on which the contract term expires — because the extension request is due 30 days after receipt of the notice on an indefinite-term lease but at the latest 60 days before expiry of the term on a fixed-term lease, a backward-running deadline that can already have passed when the notice arrives.
quotes: Der Mieter kann die Erstreckung eines befristeten oder unbefristeten Mietverhältnisses verlangen, wenn die Beendigung der Miete für ihn oder seine Familie eine Härte zur Folge hätte, die durch die Interessen des Vermieters nicht zu rechtfertigen wäre.

This determination is what makes the hardship layer of the contract removable in its entirety.

decisions.must_determine: Whether the ending of the tenancy would cause the tenant or the tenant's family a hardship not justified by the landlord's interests, weighing in particular the circumstances of the conclusion and the content of the contract, the duration of the tenancy, the personal, family and economic circumstances of both parties and their conduct, any own need of the landlord and its urgency, and conditions on the local market; and, on a second extension, whether the tenant did everything that could reasonably be required of him to avert the hardship.

Verlangt der Mieter eine zweite Erstreckung, so berücksichtigt die zuständige Behörde auch, ob er zur Abwendung der Härte alles unternommen hat, was ihm zuzumuten war.

decisions.must_determine: The extension sought and its admissible length and number: at most four years for residential and six years for commercial premises, granted as one or two extensions within that maximum; and, where the parties agree an extension themselves, that no maximum binds them and the tenant may waive a second extension. Where the tenancy is a sublease, the extension can run only for the duration of the head lease.

decisions.must_determine: Which conciliation authority is competent — the one covering the place where the premises are situated. The list of authorities and their territorial competence is itself a mandatory content of the termination form, and the cantons are obliged to publish their composition and competence periodically.
quotes: Für Klagen aus Miete und Pacht unbeweglicher Sachen ist das Gericht am Ort der gelegenen Sache zuständig.
das Verzeichnis der Schlichtungsbehörden und ihre örtliche Zuständigkeit.
Die Kantone sind verpflichtet, die Zusammensetzung der Schlichtungsbehörden und deren Zuständigkeit periodisch zu veröffentlichen.
Es ist jeweils diejenige Schlichtungsbehörde zuständig, in deren Gerichtsregion sich die Wohn- oder Geschäftsräume befinden.

decisions.must_determine: Whether an attempt at conciliation must precede the decision proceedings, and whether any statutory exemption (ZPO 198) or waiver (ZPO 199 — joint waiver at a value of at least CHF 100,000; unilateral waiver where the defendant is domiciled abroad or whose whereabouts are unknown) applies. The outcome decides whether the court-stage annex is the Klagebewilligung or the declaration that conciliation is waived.
quotes: Dem Entscheidverfahren geht ein Schlichtungsversuch vor einer Schlichtungsbehörde voraus.

die Klagebewilligung oder die Erklärung, dass auf das Schlichtungsverfahren verzichtet werde;

decisions.must_determine: What the conciliation request must contain and by when and in what form it must be filed: the opposing party, the prayer for relief and the subject matter, in the forms of ZPO 130 or orally on the record, with the supporting documents, in the number of paper copies the cantonal authority requires. The authority then serves it on the opposing party without delay and summons both parties at the same time.

Die Schlichtungsbehörde stellt der Gegenpartei das Schlichtungsgesuch unverzüglich zu und lädt gleichzeitig die Parteien zur Vermittlung vor.
die Urkunden (in Kopie und im Doppel), welche als Beweismittel dienen sollen. Der Mietvertrag ist immer einzureichen.
in doppelter Ausführung einreichen (Art. 131 ZPO)

decisions.must_determine: Who must appear personally at the conciliation hearing and whether a representation exception applies: parties must appear in person and may be accompanied by counsel or a person of trust; a party domiciled outside the canton or abroad, a party prevented by illness, age or other important reasons, and — on the landlord's side — a delegated Liegenschaftsverwaltung may be represented, the last only if authorised in writing to conclude a settlement. The opposing party must be informed of the representation in advance.
quotes: Die Parteien müssen persönlich zur Schlichtungsverhandlung erscheinen.

eine Vollmacht bei Vertretung;

decisions.must_determine: What must be produced at the conciliation hearing: the authority has documents laid before it and may carry out an inspection, and where an Entscheidvorschlag or a decision of its own is in contemplation it may also take the other means of proof so long as this does not materially delay the proceedings. The hearing is informal and, as a rule, not public, and party statements may neither be recorded nor later used in the decision proceedings except where the authority issues a proposal or a decision.
quotes: Die Schlichtungsbehörde lässt sich allfällige Urkunden vorlegen und kann einen Augenschein durchführen.
Soweit ein Entscheidvorschlag nach Artikel 210 oder ein Entscheid nach Artikel 212 in Frage kommt, kann sie auch die übrigen Beweismittel abnehmen, wenn dies das Verfahren nicht wesentlich verzögert.
Die Verhandlung ist nicht öffentlich.

Die Schlichtungsbehörde versucht in formloser Verhandlung, die Parteien zu versöhnen. Dient es der Beilegung des Streites, so können in einen Vergleich auch ausserhalb des Verfahrens liegende Streitfragen zwischen den Parteien einbezogen werden.
In den Angelegenheiten nach Artikel 200 ist die Schlichtungsbehörde auch Rechtsberatungsstelle.
Aussagen der Parteien dürfen weder protokolliert noch später im Entscheidverfahren verwendet werden.

Die Schlichtungsbehörden haben im Schlichtungsverfahren eine Einigung der Parteien anzustreben, die sich auf das gesamte Mietverhältnis (Höhe des Mietzinses, Dauer des Vertrags, Kündigungsfrist usw.) erstreckt.

decisions.must_determine: Which of the statutory outcomes the conciliation stage produces: an agreement recorded as a Vergleich, a Klageanerkennung or an unqualified Klagerueckzug, signed by the parties and issued to each in one copy; a proposed decision under ZPO 210(1)(b); a decision of the authority itself in a pecuniary dispute up to CHF 2000 on the claimant's application; or, failing agreement, the Klagebewilligung, which in a termination contest goes to the claimant. Claimant default makes the request deemed withdrawn; defendant default is treated as a failure to agree. Any agreement is constrained by the mandatory character of the Kuendigungsschutz provisions: the tenant can waive rights under that section only where waiver is expressly provided for, and deviating agreements are void.
quotes: Kommt es zu einer Einigung, so nimmt die Schlichtungsbehörde einen Vergleich, eine Klageanerkennung oder einen vorbehaltlosen Klagerückzug zu Protokoll und lässt die Parteien dieses unterzeichnen. Jede Partei erhält ein Exemplar des Protokolls.

Bei Säumnis der beklagten Partei verfährt die Schlichtungsbehörde, wie wenn keine Einigung zu Stande gekommen wäre (Art. 209–212).
Der Mieter kann auf Rechte, die ihm nach diesem Abschnitt zustehen, nur verzichten, wenn dies ausdrücklich vorgesehen ist.

decisions.must_determine: Whether to reject the proposed decision within 20 days of its written opening and, if a party rejects, that in a tenancy protection or extension matter the Klagebewilligung goes to the rejecting party rather than to the claimant — together with the consequence that if the action is then not filed in time the proposal is deemed acknowledged and has the effect of a legally binding decision. Rejection needs no reasons, and the proposal must itself point the parties to these effects.

Der Entscheidvorschlag gilt als angenommen und hat die Wirkungen eines rechtskräftigen Entscheids, wenn ihn keine Partei innert 20 Tagen seit der schriftlichen Eröffnung ablehnt. Die Ablehnung bedarf keiner Begründung.

Die Parteien sind im Entscheidvorschlag auf die Wirkungen nach den Absätzen 1–3 hinzuweisen.

decisions.must_determine: Whether to bring the action before the court at the place where the premises lie within the Klagefrist, and what must be annexed: a power of attorney where there is representation, the Klagebewilligung or the declaration that conciliation is waived, and the available documents intended to serve as evidence. The claim may be filed in the ZPO 130 forms or made orally on the record and need not be reasoned.

die verfügbaren Urkunden, welche als Beweismittel dienen sollen.

The date on which a first extension expires, from which the 60-day deadline for a second extension request runs backwards.

Whether the notice was given solely in order to induce the tenant to buy the let dwelling.
Whether a conciliation or court proceeding connected with the tenancy was pending when notice was given, and whether the tenant had brought it abusively.

Whether the notice was given for urgent own need of the landlord for himself or close relatives or in-laws, for arrears under OR 257d, for serious breach of the duty of care and consideration, on a sale of the object, for important reasons, or on the tenant's bankruptcy — any of which disapplies the protection windows of OR 271a(1)(d) and (e).

The hardship that the ending of the tenancy would cause the tenant or the tenant's family — in particular circumstances that make it impossible to obtain a replacement object in the time remaining before the contract ends.
The circumstances in which the contract was concluded and its content.
The duration of the tenancy to date.
The personal, family and economic circumstances of both parties and their conduct.
Any own need of the landlord for himself, close relatives or in-laws, and how urgent that need is.
Conditions on the local market for residential and commercial premises.

capabilities.must_show: Evidence must be able to fix the calendar date on which the notice entered the tenant's sphere of receipt, and to distinguish which of the three limbs applies: delivery into the letter box, handover by the post, or the first day on which the item could have been collected against a collection invitation. It must therefore carry a date attributable to the postal delivery event rather than to the drafting of the notice.

Evidence must show that the item was held for collection and the date from which collection was possible, so that the constructive-receipt limb can be applied. Required only where the notice was delivered against a collection invitation.

Evidence must reproduce the notice in the shape in which it was served, so that its written form and the presence or absence of each of the five VMWG 9(1) contents — designation of the object, effective date, notice of the duty to give reasons on request, the statutory conditions for contesting and extension, and the list of conciliation authorities — can each be read off it and checked separately. Serves F05, F07, F08, F09, F10 and F11.

Evidence must show that the form used was approved by the canton — either that it is the canton's own official form or that it bears the cantonal approval endorsement naming the approving authority and the date of approval.

Evidence must show that a distinct copy of the notice was addressed to the spouse or registered partner in that person's own name and delivered to them, as distinct from a single notice addressed jointly.
Evidence must show that the premises serve as the family home and that the tenant had a spouse or registered partner at the date of the notice. Serves F12 and F13.

Evidence must show the parties as the contract names them, the date of the contract, the description of the object, whether the term is fixed or indefinite and, if fixed, its expiry, and the duration of the tenancy to date. Serves F02, F03, F04, F18 and F36.

Evidence must show each unilateral change of contract notified during the tenancy, its content and its date, so that the temporal relation between a change the landlord sought to impose and the notice can be established.

Evidence must show the reason for the termination in the landlord's own terms, and the date on which that reason was given, so that it can be compared with the ground the landlord now advances. Serves F20 and F21.

Evidence must show that the landlord set a payment deadline in writing before terminating, that it warned of termination on unused expiry, the length of the deadline, and the date it was set — so that the statutory minimum of 30 days for residential and commercial premises can be checked.

Evidence must show that a conciliation or court proceeding connected with the tenancy was pending on the date of the notice, or concluded within the preceding three years, together with its date of conclusion and its outcome for the landlord. Serves F25 and F26.
Evidence must be documentary: the statute itself fixes the medium, requiring the tenant to show by written records that the parties settled a claim under the tenancy outside any proceeding.
Evidence must show that the tenant asserted a claim under the tenancy before the notice, what the claim was, and when it was made, so that the temporal sequence with the notice can be established.
Evidence must show that the landlord offered other residential or commercial premises, what they comprise and on what terms, so that equivalence can be assessed.

Evidence must show the circumstances that make it impossible for the tenant to obtain a replacement object in the time remaining, or the other personal, family and economic circumstances relied on, and the conduct of both parties. Serves F34, F35 and F37. No public source in this universe names a document type for this capability.
Evidence must show conditions on the local market for premises of the relevant kind at the relevant time. No public source in this universe names a document type for this capability.

Evidence must show that the landlord needs the premises for himself or for close relatives or in-laws, and how urgent that need is. No public source in this universe names a document type for this capability.

Evidence must show what the tenant did to avert the hardship — the steps taken and when — so that the authority can judge whether he did everything that could reasonably be required of him. Required only on a second extension. No public source in this universe names a document type for this capability.
Evidence must show that the person acting is authorised to act for the party named, and the scope of that authority.
Evidence must show, in writing, that the delegated property management is empowered to conclude a settlement — authority to correspond or to manage is not enough; the writing must extend to settling.

Evidence must show either that the conciliation authority granted leave to proceed, to whom and on what date, or that the parties or the claimant validly dispensed with conciliation. Serves F44 and F55.
Evidence must show the content of the agreement, its characterisation as a settlement, an acknowledgement of claim or an unqualified withdrawal, and that the parties signed it.

Evidence must show the terms of the proposed decision and the date on which it was opened in writing, since the 20-day period runs from that date and the proposal must itself point the parties to the consequences of acceptance, rejection and late filing.

Evidence must show that a party rejected the proposal, which party, and that the rejection reached the authority within 20 days of the written opening. It need not show reasons, because rejection requires none.
Evidence must show the place where the premises are situated and map it to the conciliation authority whose territorial competence covers it.
Evidence must show that the request or claim was handed in to the authority or court, or given to the Swiss Post for it, on or before the last day of the period, and the number of copies filed.
Evidence must show the written exchanges between landlord and tenant bearing on the ground of termination and their dates, in whatever medium they took place.

Evidence must show that each party required to appear did so in person, or that the party falls within one of the statutory exemptions and that the opposing party was told of the representation in advance.
Evidence must show that a party failed to appear and how the authority disposed of the proceedings in consequence.

unsupported_but_material: What documents establish hardship under OR 272(1) and the personal, family and economic circumstances under OR 272(2)(c). Bern describes hardship in substance ('circumstances that make it impossible to obtain a replacement object in the remaining time') but names no document type; Aargau supplies only the residual catch-all 'Alle weiteren Dokumente und Unterlagen, die zur Beurteilung des Sachverhalts notwendig sind.' The hardship branch therefore reaches fact and evidence capability but stops short of a named document requirement. This is the single largest hole in the scope and should be scored as such, not papered over.

What documents establish the landlord's own need and its urgency (OR 272(2)(d)) — no public source in this set names one, although the fact is expressly enumerated as a weighing factor and also appears in OR 271a(3)(a).

What documents establish conditions on the local market for residential and commercial premises (OR 272(2)(e)) — none named. VMWG Art. 11(1) supplies a comparability standard for orts- und quartierüblich rents, which is a different question and belongs to the rent-increase scope, not to extension.

What document establishes civil status, registered partnership, or that the premises serve as the family home for OR 266n, 266o and 273a — none of the five cantonal sources read names one, even though the finding carries a nullity consequence. Any reconstruction that names a specific civil-status document here has invented it.
What documents establish what the tenant did to avert the hardship on a second extension (OR 272(3)) — none named.

Whether the standstill of ZPO 145(1) applies to the OR 273 forfeiture periods. ZPO 145(2)(a) excludes the conciliation procedure from the standstill, and OR 273(4) refers the conciliation procedure to the ZPO, but the sources read do not settle the character of the OR 273 period itself. Do not encode a standstill either way.

Case law on what makes a notice contrary to good faith beyond the OR 271a(1) enumeration. OR 271(1) is a general clause and the enumeration is expressly non-exhaustive ('insbesondere'); no published decision is in this source universe.
The application of the three-limb receipt rule to a second delivery attempt. Bern states the rule for the first attempt only.

The competent conciliation authority per commune outside BE, AG, GE, TI and ZH. VMWG Art. 22 obliges the cantons to publish composition and competence periodically, and VMWG 9(1)(e) puts the list on the form itself, but the cantonal instruments were not retrieved and cannot be enumerated here.

The number of paper copies required. This is cantonal and genuinely divergent — Aargau two ('in doppelter Ausführung'), Geneva one per party plus one for the commission — and no federal rule fixes it. Any single number in a reconstruction is wrong for most cantons.

Whether the conciliation authority may issue an Entscheidvorschlag of its own motion or only on a party's application. ZPO 210(1) is permissive ('kann') and says nothing about an application; the Aargau form frames it as something the claimant requests by checkbox. The sources do not resolve the tension, and a contract should not assert either reading.

The effect of nullity under OR 266o on the running of the OR 273 periods — specifically, whether a tenant who believes the notice void must nevertheless file within 30 days to preserve the contestation and extension claims in the alternative. Operationally decisive; no source read states it.

Whether OR 271a(1)(e)'s three-year window is measured from the formal conclusion of the earlier proceeding or from some other point, and what counts as the landlord having 'substantially' lost. The statute states the test; nothing in this source set operationalises it.

How the conciliation authority internally triages, assigns or prepares a file, and what it does between receipt of the request and the hearing beyond the service and summons required by ZPO 202(3). Internal procedure with no public source; must not appear in a source-grounded contract.
